obligations.source_text: Create a vertical photorealistic fine-art fashion photograph on a luminous blue shoreline at low tide. One unmistakably adult woman in her mid-twenties walks ankle-deep through the water while steadying the brim of her straw hat. She wears an airy ankle-length white linen sundress and a natural woven straw hat, her present face carrying a small warm smile. The photographed world obeys one impossible temporal rule: every secondary trace lags exactly one second behind her present body. Her wet-sand reflection preserves the neutral face from just before her smile; her shadow keeps the lowered hand from before she touched the hat; the foam ring around her ankles outlines the foot placement from one step earlier. All three traces share the same precise delay. Her current anatomy, dress, hat, sunlight, perspective, and the unaffected sea remain physically coherent. The lens, exposure, color, and fine grain remain optically clean and natural, so the anomaly belongs to the world itself. Compose the frame as serene coastal beauty at first glance and a quiet, almost-right impossibility on the second look.

A newly designed photorealistic blue-sea portrait that preserves the prior straw-hat, white-dress, beautiful-adult-woman, reality-error, and quiet uncanny themes through one coherent world-level temporal fault rather than a digital overlay.
